title: AMFI & SEBI Regulatory Limits on Total Expense Ratio (TER)
source: Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI)
content: Total Expense Ratio (TER) represents the annual percentage of fund assets used to cover administrative, management, advertising, and operational expenses of a mutual fund scheme. SEBI Regulation 52 prescribes statutory TER caps based on Assets Under Management (AUM) slabs: Equity schemes TER is capped at 2.25% for the first ₹500 crore AUM, stepping down incrementally as AUM scales higher. Index funds and ETFs have much lower statutory TER caps (0.75% maximum).
